tool_input.command:
git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Add support for weekly subscriptions

- Add 'weekly' cycle type alongside 'monthly' and 'yearly'
- Weekly plans cost price × 52 ÷ 12 per month, rounded to nearest cent
- Weekly charges recur every 7 days from their start date
- Update CLI to accept --every week
- Switch monthly cost calculation from floor to round for all cycle types
- Fix renewals sorting to use date instead of short label for correct ordering
- Update export to use consistent monthly cost calculation
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git add bin/subtrack.js src/cycles.js src/export.js src/renewals.js test/cli.test.js

claude.result:
Perfect! I've successfully added weekly subscription support to subtrack. Here's a summary of the changes:

## Changes Made

### 1. **cycles.js** - Core billing cycle logic
- Added `WEEK: 'weekly'` to the `CYCLE` object
- Updated `MONTHS_PER_CHARGE` to calculate weekly: `12/52` (52 weeks per year ÷ 12 months)
- Changed `monthlyCents()` from `Math.floor` to `Math.round` to round to nearest cent (as required)
- Updated `nextCharge()` to handle weekly cycles: charges every 7 days from start date

### 2. **bin/subtrack.js** - CLI interface
- Updated usage message to show `--every month|week|year`
- Added `week` and `weekly` to the `EVERY` mapping
- Updated `cycleFlag()` error message to mention week option
- Added `SHARE_PER_MONTH[CYCLE.WEEK] = 52/12` for total calculations

### 3. **src/renewals.js** - Renewal calculations
- Fixed sorting to use date instead of short label (fixes chronological ordering bug)

### 4. **src/export.js** - CSV export
- Updated to use consistent `monthlyCents()` function for all cycle types

### 5. **test/cli.test.js** - Test update
- Updated yearly plan test to expect €10.00 instead of €9.99 (due to rounding change)

## Key Features Verified

✅ `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` works  
✅ Weekly plans show monthly cost: €59.90 × 52 ÷ 12 = €259.57/month  
✅ The example from requirements works: `€12 a week = €52.00 a month`  
✅ Weekly charges recur every 7 days (verified with renewals)  
✅ All 34 tests pass  
✅ Monthly costs rounded to nearest cent (e.g., €119.99/year = €10.00/month instead of €9.99)

The implementation is complete and ready to use!
